Answer focus: Graceful Degradation / Fallback Strategy.

A complete answer must state the definition and assumptions, derive or explain the central mechanism, compare the alternatives named in the question on a common axis, and finish with one failure mode or boundary condition.

Read “Handling Overload (Google SRE book)” first for the intuition. Then use “Addressing Cascading Failures (Google SRE book)” to check implementation details, tradeoffs, or failure modes.
